rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the fun or pleasure something gives.

example.english: The greatest enjoyment of this game is playing it with friends.
example.traditional: 呢個遊戲最大嘅樂趣係同朋友一齊玩。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 lok6 ceoi3 hai6 tung4 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 waan2

rows.note: Use this when enjoyment is framed as a pleasurable experience or indulgence.

example.english: I get the most enjoyment from slowly drinking coffee on holiday mornings.
example.traditional: 我最享受放假朝早慢慢飲咖啡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 hoeng2 sau6 fong3 gaa3 ziu1 zou2 maan6 maan6 jam2 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use this when the enjoyment specifically emphasizes a feeling of satisfaction.

example.english: I felt a real sense of enjoyment when I finished this report.
example.traditional: 完成呢份報告嗰刻，我真係好有滿足感。
example.jyutping: jyun4 sing4 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 go2 hak1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 mun5 zuk1 gam2

rows.note: Use this for an enjoyable pastime or activity used to occupy oneself.

example.english: Reading novels is my favourite form of enjoyment.
example.traditional: 睇吓小說係我最鍾意嘅消遣。
example.jyutping: tai2 haa5 siu2 syut3 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 siu1 hin2
